data.name: email.invitation.body
data.value:
Hello {name},
You have been invited to Vixly Control. Open this link within {hours} hours to choose your password:
{link}
If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

data.name: email.invitation.subject
data.value: You are invited to Vixly Control

data.name: email.registration.body
data.value:
Hello {name},
Thank you for registering {company} with Vixly. Your portal address will be {address}.
Confirm your email within {hours} hours with this link: {link}
If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.
Vixly

data.name: email.registration.subject
data.value: Confirm your email to continue with Vixly

data.name: email.reset.body
data.value:
Hello {name},
Open this link within {minutes} minutes to choose a new password:
{link}
If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

data.name: email.tenant_notice.banned
data.value:
Hello {name},
The Vixly account of {company} has been closed permanently.
For questions, contact us at {support}.
Vixly

data.name: email.tenant_notice.deactivated
data.value:
Hello {name},
The Vixly account of {company} has been deactivated. Your data is kept.
To reopen it, contact us at {support}.
Vixly

data.name: email.tenant_notice.reactivated
data.value:
Hello {name},
Access to Vixly for {company} has been restored.
Questions? Contact us at {support}.
Vixly

data.name: email.tenant_notice.suspended
data.value:
Hello {name},
Access to Vixly for {company} has been suspended ({category}). Your data is kept.
To resolve this, contact us at {support}.
Vixly

data.value: Deactivating is for people who have left. They cannot sign in, and their history stays in the audit log.

data.name: ui.users.action.resend_invitation.help
data.value: This sends a new invitation link. The earlier link stops working.

data.value: The second factors are removed. The person has been emailed.

data.name: ui.users.action.reset_second_factor.help
data.value: Use this when the person lost their phone or security key. It removes their authenticator app, passkeys and recovery codes and ends their sessions. They set up a new one at their next sign-in.

data.value: A password reset link is on its way.

data.name: ui.users.action.send_password_reset.help
data.value: This emails the person a link to choose a new password. You never see their password.

data.value: The account is suspended and its sessions have ended.

data.value: Suspending stops this person from signing in for now and ends their sessions. Reactivate the account later.

data.name: ui.users.invite_intro
data.value: The person gets an email with a link to choose their password and set up their second factor. The link works for 72 hours.
